verdict.rationale: Salesforce markets Agentforce agents that run 24/7 autonomously across the sales cycle (salesforce-docs-18, salesforce-docs-21) and provides CLI/agent-creation tooling (salesforce-gh-8, salesforce-probe-3) supporting agent build/deploy, but all evidence is vendor marketing or generic tooling with no independent/community confirmation of true autonomous background operation, and community comments focus on cost/complexity rather than agentic reliability.
